summary.text: Clayton Fegley is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 4B (Berthold) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Clayton Fegley's service as "House since 2018". The member page lists Clayton Fegley's committee assignments as including Political Subdivisions (Vice Chair) and the Human Services standing committees.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Clayton Fegley's occupation as Retired Farmer.
It lists these affiliations and civic roles: Ward County Emergency Management Committee; Past Township Supervisor; Board, First Western Bank & Trust; Berthold Ambulance Service.
Clayton Fegley is listed as married to Holly with 4 children and 10 grandchildren.
